papers.abstract: A proposed P/E adjustment for the margin expansion associated with AI adoption. The paper explains its earnings-sensitivity framework and adoption score, illustrates the approach with a simulated 400-stock universe, and discusses narrative and estimation risks. All exhibits use generated data; they are not a historical backtest or evidence of realized investment performance.

papers.subtitle: Screening for AI-driven margin expansion hiding inside depressed earnings
